technique_name: Come up with a solution for preventing marine pollution caused by plastic.
description: To prevent marine pollution from plastic, it is important to focus on both prevention and clean-up strategies. To prevent plastic from entering ocean waters, it is important to reduce plastic production and consumption as much as possible. This can include using reusable packaging when possible, avoiding single-use plastics, and reducing plastic packaging when possible.
